answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 12739 Country: India Title: i have a doubt. tamil nadu is famous for idly and dosa.doubt is that the rice is made to paste[ata].they keep it for one night.and then cook .within one night fermentation takes place and its quantity rises due to formation of a kind of alcholic subtance.this also causes us to sleep as soon as we eat that. my doubt is that it is allowed to eat such subtance or not? Question: i have a doubt. tamil nadu is famous for idly and dosa.doubt is that the rice is made to paste[ata].they keep it for one night.and then cook .within one night fermentation takes place and its quantity rises due to formation of a kind of alcholic subtance.this also causes us to sleep as soon as we eat that. my doubt is that it is allowed to eat such subtance or not? Answer ID: 12739 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 711/530=L/1430) There is no intoxication in idli and dosa. Rice also does not become intoxicant by keeping for one night, likewise formation of alcoholic substance will not make it unlawful if it is not intoxicating. Therefore, it is lawful to eat it, though it causes sleeping. But, if some idli or dosa causes intoxication, it will be regarded haram (unlawful). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
